## Critique
- claim-1: Correctly grounded. Source-30 makes the numerical generator count conditional on Conjecture 4.10, so it cannot supply the requested theorem.
- claim-2: Correct. For every \(m\ge1\), admissibility holds, and the dissector decomposition identifies the two Schubert-index sets. Thus the ideals are literally equal in the same integral graded ring \(A_m\), proving preservation of \(\mu_{A_m}\). This establishes only the reduction half of the certificate.
- claim-3: Correctly identifies the decisive gap. Artifact `195d651f74f369c392a9d9789becba3f3b5fd7ec8f2a6876a4cbf230fd4ead91` records absence of the required theorem; it is not itself evidence for the numerical equality. Inclusion-minimality in \(\Lambda/I_{2m,2m}\) would not establish the asserted generator number in \(A_m\).

## Repair certificates
- [source-refresh] Supply a verbatim accepted internal theorem with immutable locator asserting, for every \(m\ge1\), that
  \[
  \mu_{A_m}\!\left(\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\}\right)=\binom{2m}{m},
  \qquad A_m=H^\star(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z),
  \]
  where \(\mu_{A_m}\) counts homogeneous \(A_m\)-generators, together with all theorem hypotheses.

## Required revisions
- Insert and invoke that numerical theorem before concluding
  \[
  \mu_{A_m}(I_{w_m}^{A_m})
  =\mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m}^{A_m})
  =\binom{2m}{m}.
  \]
- Until that theorem and locator are supplied, conclude that generator-number preservation is proved but the requested certificate is not established.
